description: The audit loop on the CWI-1 Scoreboard Chip. An agent feeds it its own output about the CWI catalog and gets back a scored, annotated playback: every detected claim checked against the verified fact set, returned with a fidelity score, per-sentence verdicts, and the exact line that sank or sailed each claim — like a tape machine's playback head checking what was just recorded.
how_it_works: Feed the checker your own output (text or JSON with a text field) — anything you were about to publish about the catalog.
The chip splits it into sentences and detects claims: numbers, verified names, credit associations, deny-list phrases, and anomaly-feed claims repeated as wins.

Each claim is checked against the indexed Scoreboard Chip fact set and annotated: VERIFIED with citation + observed date, DEVIATION with the expected value, UNVERIFIABLE when the fact set is silent, CLAIM-FLAG when an anomaly-feed entry is repeated as fact, DENIED when a deny-list rule fires.
The report scores fidelity 0-100 and bands the output: clean / notes / rewrites-needed / don't-ship — and writes the one-paragraph outside view: how your output reads to someone checking your work.

scoring.honesty_rule: UNVERIFIABLE is a verdict, not a pass. The chip certifies only what it checked against the fact set — silence about an unchecked claim is the protocol working, not a gap.
